capture_rule: From the already byte-sealed complete NIST TRC ThermoML record for DOI 10.1016/j.fluid.2018.12.005, retain every directly reported experimental one-component coexistence-pressure dataset and every row in source order, with complete compound, phase, temperature, pressure, uncertainty, method and provenance records. Preserve the entire 21-dataset 176-point parent source and do not select a compound, temperature interval, pressure interval, favorable row or curve segment. Do not use any equation-of-state, vapor-pressure equation, Clausius-Clapeyron relation, interpolation, regression, correlation or model-calculated value as a measurement or derivation input.

allowed_before_target_release: admitted foundational, exact-arithmetic and finite-support claims
admitted composition, equilibrium, exchange-support, phase-rule and THERMO-001 through THERMO-011 claims
complete parent source identity and byte hash
source dataset and row ordinals only
forbidden_before_target_release: equation of state, interpolation, fit or continuum curve
selected compound, dataset, row, interval or target-derived correction
